
```jsx
import { CxNotification } from '@chassis-ui/react'
// or
import CxNotification from '@chassis-ui/react/src/react/src/components/notification/CxNotification'
```

| Property | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **className** | A string of all className you want applied to the component. | `string` \| `undefined` | - |
| **context** | Sets the context context of the component to one of Bootstrap React’s themed colors. | `'primary'` \| `'secondary'` \| `'success'` \| `'danger'` \| `'warning'` \| `'info'` \| `'dark'` \| `'light'` \| `string` | primary |
| **dismissible** | Optionally add a close button to the notification and allow it to self dismiss. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | - |
| **onClose** | Callback fired when the component requests to be closed. | `(() => void)` \| `undefined` | - |
| **variant** | Style variant for the notification. | `'solid'` \| `undefined` | - |
| **visible** | Toggle the visibility of component. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | true |
